description: This file contains implementation of dynamic type registration and storage handling functions for PyTorch, including registration of data types and layouts, creation of Python objects from storage, and type checking functions.

methods.name: registerDtypeObject
methods.description: Registers a dtype object for a given scalar type.

methods.name: registerLayoutObject
methods.description: Registers a layout object for a given layout type.

methods.name: getTHPDtype
methods.description: Retrieves the dtype object for a given scalar type.

methods.name: getTHPLayout
methods.description: Retrieves the layout object for a given layout type.

methods.name: createPyObject
methods.description: Creates a Python object wrapping a given storage.

methods.name: isStorage
methods.description: Checks if a Python object is a storage.

methods.name: createStorage
methods.description: Creates an at::Storage object from a Python object.
